note: The fixed cross-tenant attack sequence. Every attack MUST be DENIED. This is the reference the differential-style denial oracle grades against — independent of the candidate model. Weakening this table (dropping an attack case) lets the mutant that only flips that case SURVIVE, which is exactly how test/heimdall-rr-isolation-oracle.test.sh proves the acceptance table is load-bearing (falsify score drops below 1.0).

cases.attack: team A signs a dispatch naming team B's repo slug (IDOR via repo slug)
team A spoofs a request team_id=B to operate as team B
team A's job resolves team B's (or a shared global) model cred
team A reads/drains team B's task queue partition
team A supplies team B's installation_id to PR on B's repo
a compromised public surface dispatches or reads a credential
team A enqueues a task into team B's partition
